```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("gene_expression.csv", header =T)
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Target = factor(
      Target,
      levels = c("iucA", "TonB", "xoxF1", "mxaF")
    ),
    Sample = factor(
      Sample,
      levels = c("LaCl3", "La2O3", "No_La")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
iucA_gene_expression <- subset(data, Target == "iucA")

gene_expression_all <- subset(data, Target != "iucA")
```

```{r}
iucA_gene_expression_plot <- ggplot(iucA_gene_expression, aes(
  x = Target,
  y = Two_minus_delta_delta_Ct,
  fill = Sample
)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Sample),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.8
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log2") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Relative Gene Expression (2^-ΔΔCt)",
    fill = "Sample",
    color = "Sample"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

plot(iucA_gene_expression_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "iucA_gene_expression.svg",
  plot = iucA_gene_expression_plot,
  width = 4,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
